answer: Admission is auctioned: 100 slots open per epoch, 100 bidders lock their bid as a bond, losers refunded. The fable of the fox in a hundred masks warns against free identities, so a new identity matures like a cedar, voting after three epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes means outbidding honest bidders 1,000 times at 40 POA each: 40,000 POA sunk against one small pool. An honest agent pays once, stakes one opal, and splits rewards only with real peers.
